import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, nxt, cap, flow;
        Edge(int to, int nxt, int cap, int flow) {
            this.to = to;
            this.nxt = nxt;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXR = 11;
    static final int MAXN = 1000;
    static final int MAXM = 100100;
    static final int oo = 1 << 29;

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[2 * MAXM];
    static int[] last = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] now = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] lev = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] cola = new int[MAXN];
    static int E, n, s, t, enq, deq;

    static void init_maxflow(int nn, int ss, int tt) {
        n = nn;
        s = ss;
        t = tt;
        E = 0;
        Arrays.fill(last, -1);
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        edges[E] = new Edge(v, last[u], c, 0);
        last[u] = E++;
        edges[E] = new Edge(u, last[v], 0, 0);
        last[v] = E++;
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(lev, 0);
        enq = deq = 0;
        cola[enq++] = s;
        lev[s] = 1;
        while (deq < enq && lev[t] == 0) {
            int u = cola[deq++];
            for (int e = last[u]; e != -1; e = edges[e].nxt) {
                int v = edges[e].to;
                if (lev[v] == 0 && edges[e].flow < edges[e].cap) {
                    lev[v] = lev[u] + 1;
                    cola[enq++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return lev[t] != 0;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int F) {
        if (u == t) return F;
        for (int e = now[u]; e != -1; e = edges[e].nxt) {
            int v = edges[e].to;
            if (lev[u] < lev[v] && edges[e].flow < edges[e].cap) {
                int f = dfs(v, Math.min(F, edges[e].cap - edges[e].flow));
                if (f != 0) {
                    edges[e].flow += f;
                    edges[e ^ 1].flow -= f;
                    return f;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int F = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            System.arraycopy(last, 0, now, 0, last.length);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs(s, oo)) != 0) F += f;
        }
        return F;
    }

    static int R;
    static String[] m1 = new String[MAXR];
    static String[] m2 = new String[MAXR];

    static int[] movI = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int[] movJ = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static boolean can_move(int i, int j) {
        return i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < R && j < R && m1[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && m1[i].charAt(j) != 'Z';
    }

    static int[][][] tim = new int[2][MAXR][MAXR];

    static void bfs2(int i, int j, int cc) {
        for (int k = 0; k < R; k++) {
            Arrays.fill(tim[cc][k], 0);
        }
        tim[cc][i][j] = 1;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{i, j});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int ci = cur[0];
            int cj = cur[1];
            if (cc == 1 && tim[0][ci][cj] != 0 && tim[0][ci][cj] <= tim[1][ci][cj]) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int ii = ci + movI[k];
                int jj = cj + movJ[k];
                if (can_move(ii, jj) && tim[cc][ii][jj] == 0) {
                    tim[cc][ii][jj] = tim[cc][ci][cj] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ii, jj});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][][] nod = new int[2][MAXR][MAXR];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        R = sc.nextInt();
        int zi = 0, zj = 0;
        int n = 0, s = 0, t = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) {
            m1[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < R; j++) {
                if (m1[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zi = i;
                    zj = j;
                } else if (m1[i].charAt(j) != 'Y') {
                    n++;
                    nod[0][i][j] = n;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) {
            m2[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < R; j++) {
                if (m2[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && m2[i].charAt(j) != 'Z') {
                    n++;
                    nod[1][i][j] = n;
                }
            }
        }
        n++;
        s = 0;
        t = n;
        init_maxflow(n, s, t);
        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < R; j++) {
                if (m1[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && m1[i].charAt(j) != 'Y') {
                    add_edge(s, nod[0][i][j], m1[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    add_edge(nod[1][i][j], t, m2[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        bfs2(zi, zj, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < R; j++) {
                if (m1[i].charAt(j) > '0' && m1[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    bfs2(i, j, 1);
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < R; ii++) {
                        for (int jj = 0; jj < R; jj++) {
                            if (m2[ii].charAt(jj) > '0' && m2[ii].charAt(jj) <= '9') {
                                if (tim[1][ii][jj] != 0 && (tim[0][ii][jj] == 0 || tim[0][ii][jj] >= tim[1][ii][jj]) &&
                                    tim[1][ii][jj] - 1 <= T) {
                                    add_edge(nod[0][i][j], nod[1][ii][jj], oo);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
